rationale: INTC has experienced a sharp opening selloff of nearly $2.00 in the first five minutes on 2.64x relative volume, immediately rejecting its 09:34 bounce from $64.25 back down to $63.83. While momentum is heavily bearish and showing strong relative weakness against a rising broader market, shorting at 3.3% of the day's range just above the $63.76 session low and $63.20 prior-day low presents poor reward-to-risk, while going long has no structural confirmation as the initial bounce just failed.
